scoring_justification: Checker fully recomputes ℓ_c from raw C(r) data and verifies constancy of ℓ_c √δz; no trust of self-reported values is required for the main weight.

hidden_assets.purpose: Tolerance for constancy check (CV < 0.1) derived from the paper's claim that ℓ_c ~ δz^{-1/2}.
hidden_assets.generation_method: constancy condition translated into CV threshold; no external dataset needed
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Direct mathematical consequence of the paper's main result. Used to set scoring threshold.

outputs.description: Bond response function C(r) averaged over bond pairs at distance r, for each δz. The checker recomputes ℓ_c from this raw data.
Extracted lengthscale ℓ_c for each δz. The checker recomputes ℓ_c independently from step_01 and cross-checks these reported values.

output_contract.notes: The main scientific claim is that ℓ_c and δz are related by a well-defined scaling law. The checker recomputes ℓ_c from the C(r) data and verifies the consistency of the inferred scaling relationship.
